steps.name: Your Nationality
notices: This is the only official portal where eligible travellers can apply for their electronic visa (eVisa).

steps.name: Purpose of Travel — Tourist Visa
notices: Once in Brazil, you are authorised to stay for up to 90 days per year and if you need to extend your stay beyond 90 days, contact the Federal Police. The eVisa is valid for 5 years on Multiple entries.
Photograph Recent Photograph of the applicant (Photograph specifications link in pdf)
Passport Bio Page Color copy of the applicant's passport bio page (Photograph specifications link in pdf. Your Passport must be valid for at least 1 month before arrival)
Consular offices may request additional documents at their discretion.
Even if you hold a diplomatic or special passport you still require an entry eVisa.
Processing takes up to 10 business days once your verified application is submitted.
Upon arrival, airport authorities will verify your entry authorization. To avoid issues, carry your valid passport and a printed copy of your eVisa PDF (downloadable from the dashboard)
